content.text: Based on your GreenScore of 74/100, your biggest opportunity right now is solar: your SolarScore shows High suitability with an estimated annual generation of 3,500 kWh at this location. That's a modelled estimate from PVGIS, not a survey of your actual roof, so a qualified MCS-certified installer would need to confirm feasibility before you commit to anything. Alongside that, electricity is currently at a moderate carbon intensity, and there's a cleaner window forecast for later today — a good time to run any flexible appliances if that fits your routine.
